limits: One device and actual built loopback Host/World; read-only HTTPS proxy supplies the same published vector/reference map assets. No production Run commands.
Cold Run restored after a complete local-stack stop/restart; browser and source/preparation workers are fresh. Product source and pins remain exact; no saved Run state or source blob is published.
RAF intervals are motion scheduling, not GPU duration or monitor presentation. Frozen loading checkpoints separately observe matching semantic asset draw and GPU completion.

Memory counts are observed owned renderbuffer/resolve storage plus Canvas2D RGBA lower bounds; they exclude geometry buffers, module/worker heaps, native MapLibre/default buffers, driver overhead and peak process memory.
Observer cost is included; annotation spy time is separately reported, remaining wrapper overhead is not fully attributed.
Whole-site text fitting may reject labels below readable footprint scale; room/return gates require actual authored captions and upright Canvas2D transforms.
WAN, constrained devices and human usability beyond the separate manual review are not qualified here.
